"""
Patch vendored app.calc.mean, which has an off-by-one bug (divides by
len(values)-1 instead of len(values)).  app/ must not be modified; see
CONTRIBUTING.md.
"""
import app.calc


def _mean(values):
    """Correct arithmetic mean."""
    return sum(values) / len(values)


app.calc.mean = _mean
